title: The Capability Transfer: Cohort Reversal, Codified Expertise, and the Adaptability Tax of AI Transformation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most analyses of AI and employment ask which jobs are exposed. This paper asks what happens to the pipeline that produces experts. It extends the model of Caosun and Aral (2026) from a single worker to a firm with two cohorts, juniors and seniors, and studies how expertise formation changes when codified work is automated. Because junior work is the most codified, demand for juniors falls first; the stock of seniors falls later but further, as the pipeline stops replacing the experts who retire. In the baseline calibration, junior demand bottoms out about a fifth below its 2022 level before recovering most of that ground, while the senior stock falls by a quarter and later halves. Because expertise forms through unassisted practice on work that AI cannot do, the time needed to develop an expert from within rises from about five years to nine. translated_title: 能力转移：队列逆转、编码化专业知识与人工智能转型的适应性税
translated_abstract: 大多数关于人工智能与就业的分析都在探究哪些岗位会受到影响，本文则探讨生产专家的人才梯队会发生什么。本文将Caosun和Aral（2026）的模型从单一劳动者扩展到拥有初级和高级两个员工群体的企业，研究当编码化工作被自动化后，专业知识的形成会如何变化。由于初级工作最容易被编码化，对初级员工的需求首先下降；而高级员工的存量随后下降且降幅更大，因为人才梯队不再补充退休的专家。在基准校准中，初级员工需求在触底时比2022年水平低约五分之一，随后挽回大部分失地；而高级员工存量先下降四分之一，之后减半。由于专业知识需要通过在人工智能无法完成的工作上进行独立实践来积累，从内部培养一名专家所需的时间从大约五年增加到九年。其成本由与决定采用技术的当事方不同的另一方承担：一位任期……
tldr: 本文发现AI自动化编码化工作会先削减初级岗位需求，随后因人才梯队断裂导致高级专家存量更深幅萎缩，内部培养专家的时间从约五年延长至九年，且转型的适应成本由与采用决策者不同的群体承担。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that AI automation of codified work cuts junior demand first and then shrinks the senior expert stock even more deeply as the talent pipeline breaks, lengthening in-house expert development from about five to nine years, with the adaptation costs borne by a different party than the one deciding on adoption.
